ring_powers.description: The Rings of Power grant extraordinary abilities to their bearers. Each Ring has unique effects, and the One Ring dominates all others.

the_one_ring.name: The One Ring
the_one_ring.description: The ultimate artifact of power. Grants invisibility, extended life, and the ability to command all other Ring-bearers.

powers.name: Invisibility
powers.description: Shifts the wearer to the Wraith-world, making them invisible to normal sight.
powers.effect: Wearer is invisible; enemy units cannot target the wearer directly
powers.drawback: Prolongs exposure weakens the wearer's physical form

powers.name: Domination
powers.description: Commands all bearers of the Nine Rings (Nazgûl) and weakens the will of other Ring-bearers.
powers.effect: All Nazgûl units gain +2 attack and +2 speed; enemy Ring-bearers suffer -1 to all rolls

powers.name: Corruption
powers.description: The Ring gradually corrupts the wearer's soul, increasing the corruption track.
powers.effect: Corruption track advances by 1 stage each round the Ring is worn
powers.drawback: At maximum corruption, the wearer claims the Ring and is lost

powers.name: Extended Life
powers.description: Halts aging but does not grant true life. The wearer becomes unhealthily ageless.
powers.effect: Wearer does not age; immune to time-based effects
powers.drawback: The wearer cannot die of old age but can be killed; existence becomes a burden

powers.name: Rekindle Hope
powers.description: Rekindles the hearts of the free and inspires hope and courage in times of despair.
powers.effect: All friendly units within range gain +1 attack and +1 defense dice; Hope resource increases by 2

powers.name: Fire of Antú
powers.description: Commands the fire of the Undying Lands, purifying and destroying evil.
powers.effect: Deals 3 damage to all enemy units within range; heals 2 hull wounds to friendly units

powers.name: Preservation
powers.description: Preserves and protects, maintaining Lothlórien's timeless beauty and shielding it from decay.
powers.effect: All friendly units in Lothlórien system are immune to corruption and degradation; shields regenerate each round

powers.name: Shield of Lothlórien
powers.description: Creates a powerful shield of water and light around allies.
powers.effect: All friendly units within range gain +3 shields for 2 rounds

powers.name: Most Powerful of the Three
powers.description: The most powerful of the Three Elven Rings. Enhances the wearer's inherent abilities.
powers.effect: Wearer gains +1 to all stats; all friendly units within range gain +1 defense

powers.name: Refuge of Rivendell
powers.description: Maintains Rivendell as a safe haven, protected from the Shadow.
powers.effect: Rivendell system cannot be targeted by enemy actions; friendly units in Rivendell heal 2 hull wounds per round

wizard_abilities.description: The Istari (Wizards) are Maiar bound in mortal form. Their powers are restricted but still formidable.

powers.name: Maiar Power
powers.description: As a Maia, Gandalf possesses immense spiritual power, though restricted by his mortal form.
powers.effect: Gandalf can unleash a burst of light and power, dealing 4 damage to all enemies within range and healing 3 wounds to all allies

powers.name: Staff of Office
powers.description: Gandalf's staff channels his power. Breaking it temporarily weakens him.
powers.effect: Strike an enemy with the staff for 3 damage; can also be used to bar doors or create light

powers.name: Fireworks
powers.description: Gandalf's signature ability — creating spectacular displays of light to distract and demoralize enemies.
powers.effect: All enemy units within range suffer -1 attack and -1 defense for 1 round; Fear effect

powers.name: Healing
powers.description: Gandalf can heal wounds and restore vitality to his allies.
powers.effect: Restore 3 hull wounds to a friendly unit within range

powers.name: Pegasus Command
powers.description: Gandalf can command Shadowfax, Lord of all horses.
powers.effect: Gandalf can summon Shadowfax for transport; Shadowfax is swiftest of living creatures

powers.name: Voice of Authority
powers.description: Saruman's voice can compel obedience and inspire terror.
powers.effect: All enemy units within range must pass a will check or become stunned for 1 round

powers.name: Industrial Mastery
powers.description: Saruman's knowledge of industry and technology allows him to produce war machines.
powers.effect: Isengard factories produce +1 unit per round; Uruk-hai gain +1 attack

powers.name: Palantír User
powers.description: Saruman uses the Palantír of Orthanc to communicate and gather intelligence.
powers.effect: Reveal all enemy units in one system; can communicate with Sauron (risk of domination)

powers.name: Uruk-hai Creation
powers.description: Saruman bred the Uruk-hai, an improved orc-line.
powers.effect: Uruk-hai units can operate in sunlight and are +1 stronger than standard orcs

powers.name: Nature's Call
powers.description: Radagast can command animals and plants.
powers.effect: Summon 2 animal units (wolves, birds, etc.) or cause plants to entangle enemy units

powers.name: Healing of the Earth
powers.description: Radagast can heal the land and its creatures.
powers.effect: Restore 2 hull wounds to all friendly units within range; restore a damaged system

racial_traits.description: Each race in the Arda galaxy has unique traits that affect gameplay.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.effect: Elven units gain +1 to attack and defense dice; can detect hidden units

traits.name: Elven Grace
traits.effect: Elven units gain +1 speed; can move through difficult terrain without penalty

traits.name: Starlight Camouflage
traits.effect: Elven units in forest or night conditions gain stealth; cannot be targeted by ranged attacks at long range

traits.name: Immortality
traits.effect: Elven characters cannot die of old age; if killed, they may choose to sail to Valinor

traits.name: Númenórean Bloodline
traits.effect: Dúnedain units gain +1 hull and +1 wounds; longer-lived than normal Men

traits.name: Ambition
traits.effect: Men units gain +1 attack when near a commander; can achieve great feats but are susceptible to corruption

traits.name: The Gift of Ilúvatar
traits.effect: Men can depart the world entirely; death is not a curse but a gift. Men units do not suffer from fading.

traits.name: Stubborn Defense
traits.effect: Dwarven units gain +2 defense when holding a position; cannot be forced to retreat

traits.name: Underground Warfare
traits.effect: Dwarven units gain +1 attack and +1 defense in underground or asteroid environments

traits.name: Mithril Armor
traits.effect: Dwarven units with mithril armor gain +2 shields; lighter than steel but stronger

traits.name: Treasure-lust
traits.effect: Dwarven units gain +1 attack when near treasure or valuable resources; may refuse to leave valuable sites

traits.name: Small and Overlooked
traits.effect: Hobbit units are stealthy; enemy units cannot target them at long range unless they attack first

traits.name: Ring Resistance
traits.effect: Hobbit units have +2 resistance to corruption; the Ring's power over them is weaker

traits.name: Unexpected Courage
traits.effect: When a hobbit unit is at 1 hull wound, it gains +1 attack and +1 defense for 1 round (desperation)

traits.name: Second Breakfast
traits.effect: Hobbit units can restore 1 hull wound by taking a meal action; food is a powerful resource

traits.name: Immense Strength
traits.effect: Ent units deal +2 damage in melee; can destroy fortifications in a single hit

traits.name: Nearly Indestructible
traits.effect: Ent units gain +3 defense; conventional weapons deal -1 damage

traits.name: Ent-drum
traits.effect: Ents can coordinate with an Ent-drum; all Ent units within range gain +1 attack and +1 defense

traits.name: Slow Deliberation
traits.effect: Ent units have speed 1; cannot be rushed but are nearly unstoppable once committed

traits.name: Mass Produced
traits.effect: Orc units are cheap and numerous; can be produced in large quantities

traits.name: Hatred of Light
traits.effect: Orc units suffer -1 attack and -1 defense in sunlight or near elven light sources

traits.name: Brute Force
traits.effect: Orc units gain +1 attack in melee; favor overwhelming numbers over skill

traits.name: Infighting
traits.effect: Orc units may turn on each other if not properly commanded; -1 defense when no commander is nearby

traits.name: Spiritual Nature
traits.effect: Maiar units can take physical form at will; immune to conventional weapons (take half damage)

traits.name: Ancient Power
traits.effect: Maiar units have access to powerful abilities; their true power is restricted by their mortal form

traits.name: Before Time
traits.effect: Maiar units existed before the world; they have ancient knowledge and wisdom

unit_keywords.description: Common keywords that modify unit stats and behaviors.

keywords.name: Elite
keywords.effect: Unit is an elite warrior. Gains +1 attack and +1 defense. More expensive but more effective.

keywords.name: Commander
keywords.effect: Unit is a commander. Friendly units within range gain +1 attack and +1 defense.

keywords.name: Ring-bearer
keywords.effect: Unit carries the One Ring. Subject to corruption track. Must reach Mount Doom.

keywords.name: Wraith
keywords.effect: Unit is a wraith. Invisible to normal sight; immune to conventional weapons. Vulnerable to elven weapons and water.

keywords.name: Siege
keywords.effect: Unit is a siege weapon. Can destroy fortifications but is slow and vulnerable to ranged attacks.

keywords.name: Fast
keywords.effect: Unit has high speed. Can move twice per activation but has reduced defense.

keywords.name: Ancient
keywords.effect: Unit is ancient. Has immense power but is slow to act and rare.

keywords.name: Corrupted
keywords.effect: Unit is corrupted by the Ring. Gains +1 attack but suffers -1 defense and may turn on allies.

keywords.name: Hope
keywords.effect: Unit generates Hope. Friendly units within range gain +1 defense dice.

keywords.name: Fear
keywords.effect: Unit inspires Fear. Enemy units within range suffer -1 attack and -1 defense.
